notes: This repo stores exact published skill snapshots under version directories.
Compare candidate versions by the source commit date recorded in each version's source.json file.
When no version is requested, enumerate all version directories and choose the maximum candidate by the compare strategy.
When multiple dependency requests mention different versions of openai/pdf, choose the maximum requested version by the same comparator.
Do not apply LLAR formula-style highest-less-than-or-equal matching here. Version directories are exact artifacts, not fromVer ranges.
